description: Mark Document Uploads as recycled. Filled-placeholder uploads are jointly recycled with their placeholder.

400.description:
Validation errors in request body

Possible reason codes:
- MISSING_REQUIRED_PROPERTY
- INVALID_PROPERTY
- INVALID_BODY

401.description:
Missing or invalid authentication token

Possible reason codes:
- INVALID_TOKEN

403.description:
User lacks recycle permissions for this project, lacks UploadedBy permission for a standalone upload, or is not the placeholder creator for a filled-placeholder upload (or the umbrella feature flag is OFF)

Possible reason codes:
- ACCESS_DENIED

422.description:
One or more standalone document_upload_ids do not exist, are already recycled or deleted, or do not belong to the company/project

Possible reason codes:
- INVALID_INPUT

document_upload_ids.description: Array of Document Upload IDs to be sent to recycle bin (max 100).

recycle_reason.description: Reason for recycling the document upload
